name: carelink-bridge
description: Bridge that sends Medtronic CareLink pump and CGM data to Nightscout by simulating the CareLink mobile app's OAuth2 authentication and API calls.

scripts.drift:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='../carelink-api-research/regression/hurl/run.sh';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('sister repo not found at ../carelink-api-research — clone it next to this one:');console.error('  git clone https://github.com/NovaLux12/carelink-api-research.git');process.exit(2)}const miss=['hurl','jq'].filter(b=>{try{require('child_process').execFileSync('sh',['-c','command -v '+b],{stdio:'ignore'});return false}catch{return true}});if(miss.length){console.error('drift:check cannot run — missing: '+miss.join(', '));console.error('  hurl: https://github.com/Orange-OpenSource/hurl  (macOS: brew install hurl)');console.error('  jq:   https://jqlang.github.io/jq/');console.error('A missing tool is NOT vendor drift — exiting without probing.');process.exit(2)}const r=require('child_process').spawnSync(p,[],{stdio:'inherit',env:{...process.env,DELAY_MS:process.env.DELAY_MS||'2000'}});if(r.error){console.error(String(r.error.message));process.exit(2)}process.exit(r.status===null?1:r.status)"
